description: The plot illustrates how loss changes over training time for two methods, “Vanilla” and “SepLLM.” The x-axis is labeled “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 250,000 seconds with regularly spaced tick labels every 50,000 seconds. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick labels at 0.05 intervals (2.40, 2.45, 2.50, …, 2.75). One line represents Vanilla as a purple solid curve with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts near the top of the axis around 2.75 at early training times, decreases steeply by about 50,000 s to roughly 2.62, then continues a gradual decline to about 2.50 by 250,000 s. The other line represents SepLLM as a red solid curve with circular markers; it begins around 2.71 near the left side, drops to roughly 2.61 by about 50,000 s, and then declines more gradually to approximately 2.48–2.49 by around 230,000–240,000 s. A green dashed horizontal reference line is drawn at approximately loss 2.50, and green dashed vertical guide lines appear near 200,000 s and 250,000 s with a green double-headed arrow labeled “1.26×” spanning between those vertical guides.
